(3) Next, the man is seen on the sofa again while the cat lies on a white cloth on a black coffee table. (4) A person in a pink shirt is then shown holding the cat against their chest, with only their arms and torso visible. (5) A digital scale is shown on the floor with feet stepping on it, displaying weight numbers. (6) The cat is seen walking past several pairs of white sneakers on a dark floor.
